title: Hello, Singapore
click: Start opens character selection. Returning adopted saves open Home instead.
back: Back opens device options; it never erases a save.
layout: Header 0,0 320x24; logo panel 24,40 272x148; portraits 60x60; action rail y194.
states: Returning save bypasses onboarding. Unreadable server save shows Save error.
motion: Optional brief logo reveal, then still. Reduced motion skips reveal.

title: Choose your Pal
click: Press a species to open a confirmation. Adoption is not saved yet.
layout: Three 96x116 cards at x8/112/216, y36; 64x64 portraits; description y170.
states: Confirmation offers Choose or Back; selection survives Back.
motion: Focused sprite can tilt or blink; no animation required to perceive focus.

title: Confirm companion
click: Choose proceeds to suggested naming.
states: No saved-game mutation before naming confirmation.
motion: Single happy reaction.

title: A name for your Pal
click: Keep commits adoption and opens Home; Reroll cycles three preset names.
states: Save failure preserves previous save and offers Retry/Back. Phone naming belongs to phase3.
motion: Name changes immediately; short success reaction after saved response.

title: My BTO
click: Pal opens interaction; Scan opens scanner; Menu opens scrolling menu.
back: Root screen; Settings remains available via Menu.
layout: Header24px; room0,24 320x168; 56x56 sprite container147,112; actions y194.
states: Local save status appears in Settings. Offline play keeps local profile; no pending reward grants.
motion: Target 4-frame idle at4fps, gentle fan 2-frame loop. Prototype remains still.

title: Pocket menu
focus: CultureDex > Quests > Shop > Inventory > Decorate > Profile > Rooms > Friends > Settings > Back
click: Press opens the focused destination; rotation scrolls four visible rows.
back: Explicit Back is the final row.
layout: Four296x30 rows at y36/72/108/144. Footer y224.
states: Phase2-4 screens show empty/unconnected states in live mode.
motion: No sliding transition; immediate page change avoids expensive redraw effects.

title: A moment with your Pal
click: Explore opens scanner.
states: No hunger, decay or daily-care penalty.
motion: A brief greeting reaction; no currency for repeat interactions.

title: Camera scanner
click: Camera requests browser camera only after press; Upload opens system photo picker.
layout: Preview16,36 288x145; rail194. Photo pixels are not filtered as pixel art.
states: No assumption of Pi camera. Permission or insecure-context error offers Upload/Retry/Back.
motion: No camera frames until permission granted. Actual preview capped near10fps.

title: AI not connected
click: Returns to photo review.
states: Backend /api/scan and /api/verify return501. No credentials or API calls included.
motion: Static integration-needed state.

title: Camera unavailable
click: Upload uses picker; Retry requests permission again if browser allows.
layout: Icon and three lines; three actions.
states: Distinct permission denial/insecure context/device absence message.
motion: No indefinite loading spinner.

title: Camera ready
click: Capture freezes the real frame for review; no AI request is made in this prototype.
layout: Image16,32 288x152; fit/letterbox with normal photo interpolation.
states: Gallery is explicitly a camera placeholder, not a fake photograph.
motion: Live preview10fps; stop tracks on exit and page hide.

title: Review your photo
click: Analyse currently shows integration-needed state. It never saves a discovery.
back: Scanner. Captured photo remains memory-only until replaced or page closes.
states: Oversized/unsupported files rejected before decode. No upload to external services.
motion: Still photograph, no artificial pixel filter.

title: Camera permission
click: Cancels pending request in app; late media streams are immediately stopped.
states: Browser permission dialog owns approval. No success while permission unresolved.
motion: Optional two-frame thinking loop.

title: Discovery saved
click: Dex opens saved detail; Quest opens board. This is a sample success state only.
layout: Item64x40, title; reward strip12,108 296x38; quest alert y161.
states: Show only after atomic save+reward commit in future backend. Duplicate uses06duplicate.
motion: Target brief sparkle and one coin tick; reduced motion uses static reward strip.

title: Check the AI suggestion
click: In future integrated flow, Yes confirms a vetted ID; No retakes/corrects without reward. Gallery only here.
states: Uncertain/no cultural match must not auto-save. Correction UI offers retry; no free-text requirement.
motion: Small thinking reaction before decision, not a reward animation.

title: Already discovered
click: Open existing entry or quest; no reward transaction.
states: Duplicate recognition must not create another reward event or overwrite original photo silently.
motion: Gentle acknowledgement, no celebration.

title: Try a clearer view
click: Retry opens scanner without granting anything.
layout: Three short lines and two actions.
states: Future alternative candidates may replace retry when available.
motion: Calm reaction; no punitive failure animation.

title: CultureDex
focus: Visible entries in numeric order > Next > Back
click: Open entry; Next shows next catalogue page. Empty live state offers Scan.
states: Unknowns remain numbered with???; empty Dex uses invitation, not an empty grid.
motion: Immediate focus move; no list bounce.

title: CultureDex next page
click: Unknown entry opens locked page.
states: Pages never contain fake unlocked entries.
motion: None.

title: CultureDex story
click: Next opens Photo, then Quest metadata, then Story.
back: Catalogue with previous focus restored in future implementation.
states: Explanation is curated example text. Actual approved recognition supplies entry ID.
motion: Static reading page.

title: Unknown CultureDex entry
click: Scan opens camera selector.
states: Do not reveal private or undiscovered details.
motion: Optional subtle question-mark idle.

title: CultureDex photograph
click: Next opens quest metadata.
states: Placeholder is explicitly not an actual scan. Real photo must display the captured timestamp in Asia/Singapore.
motion: No pixel filter applied to photos.

title: CultureDex quest
click: Open story or associated quest detail.
states: XP shown belongs to discovery event; quest reward remains unclaimed.
motion: None.

title: Quest board
focus: Active quest > Completed > Locked > Back; empty: Scan > Back
click: Open quest detail or selected status list.
states: Empty real save has no invented quest. Completed entry is non-claimable.
motion: New quest can receive a brief marker, not constant flashing.

title: Completed quest
click: No claim action for completed quest.
states: Sample only; no additional reward on revisit.
motion: No repeated celebration.

title: Locked quest
click: Read prerequisite.
states: Prerequisite explicit; no selectable Verify.
motion: None.

title: Quest verification
click: Integrated version captures fresh evidence for this quest ID. Gallery opens checking sample.
layout: Three instructions; reward strip12,118 296x37; requirement y168.
states: No success without verifier pass. In runnable prototype no live active quests exist.
motion: Thinking loop only while an actual request is pending.

title: Evidence needs another try
click: Retry requests fresh evidence; Back retains quest.
states: Needs-more-evidence differs from system error. No blame or punishment.
motion: Quiet curious reaction, no red flashing.

title: Quest verified
click: Show completed record. Sample UI only; never reachable from a real unverified request.
layout: Portrait; title; reward strip; two actions.
states: Render only after verified and committed, not from client timer or capture event.
motion: One6-frame celebration; reduced motion still reward strip.

title: Evidence being checked
click: Cancels request view; late response must be reconciled by backend operation ID.
states: Static sample does not auto-transition to success. Request timeout offers Retry/Back.
motion: Target four-frame thinking loop; timer cannot imply a pass.

title: Kopi shop
click: Buy opens confirmation only if affordable; actual purchase is not enabled in prototype.
layout: Item art40x60; label/price right; affordability line141.
states: Insufficient coins and unavailable stock have separate states. Categories can reuse paged lists.
motion: Focused item can rise1px; never jiggle disabled actions.

title: Confirm purchase
click: Prototype reports not connected; future backend atomically debits25 and adds item.
states: Recheck balance/owned state on server; reject duplicate transaction IDs.
motion: Purchase reaction only after committed response.

title: Insufficient coins
click: Explore opens scanner; no negative balance.
states: Price and gap visible before confirmation.
motion: None.

title: Shop item unavailable
click: Browse available item or leave.
states: No active Buy control when unavailable.
motion: None.

title: Inventory
focus: Furniture > Accessories > Special > Back; empty: Shop > Back
click: Owned furniture opens placement. Empty categories give informative state.
states: Show Owned/Placed/Equipped distinctions in future item list; no duplication.
motion: None.

title: Decorate by slots
click: Next cycles compatible fixed slots; Place opens confirmation, never drag-and-drop.
states: Sample window plant only; live save has no item and cannot commit placement.
motion: Solid slot outline; target brief before/after swap after save.

title: Confirm placement
click: Prototype shows integration needed. Future save validates ownership and slot.
states: Save failure must preserve original room and retryable edit.
motion: Swap preview only; commit animation follows successful save.

title: Alternate furniture slot
click: Select next compatible placement slot.
states: Production save references stable slot IDs, not browser coordinates.
motion: None.

title: Pal profile
click: More shows accessories/personality/achievements.
layout: 70x70 portrait, labels;288x12 XP bar; 2 metadata lines.
states: Live level1/0XP; example level3 uses140/200. XP never spent.
motion: Idle portrait; progress animates only on actual earned XP.

title: Profile details
click: Read profile details.
states: Personality copy will vary by species. No invented unlocked achievements.
motion: None.

title: Room expansion
click: Enter unlocked room; locked room explains milestone.
layout: Three room rows; short level requirement in each.
states: Thresholds5/8 are proposed balancing, not committed economy. Study/balcony future pages.
motion: Room transition as brief fade optional; reduced motion immediate.

title: Room milestone
click: Return to room list.
states: Use actual selected room requirement in production.
motion: None.

title: Friends
focus: Friend > Requests > Add > Back; live: Back
click: Gallery previews asynchronous social UI. Live has no social calls.
layout: Three list rows or explicit unconnected state.
states: Future friend rooms are private by default; authorised friends only.
motion: Small status marker; no live-presence assumption.

title: Add friend by phone
click: Production replaces labelled placeholder with actual short-lived server QR.
layout: 88x88 QR region plus2 lines. Real QR may need larger region after device tests.
states: Never display decorative QR as usable code; no unauthorised room URL.
motion: Pairing expiry shows Refresh, no polling when not paired.

title: Friend request
click: Future server-backed consent action; prototype does not change social state.
states: Show verified account identity in production, not only pet name.
motion: No reward for accepting.

title: Visit a friend
click: Greet opens preset guestbook choices; no room editing.
states: Sample house only. Real snapshot requires permission and excludes CultureDex scan photos.
motion: Friend sprite can idle locally; does not imply real-time presence.

title: Leave a greeting
click: Future sends selected sticker/message once with confirmation. No unrestricted chat.
states: Sending must show pending, sent or failed. Prototype sends nothing.
motion: One sticker pop only after successful send.

title: Settings and save
click: Sound saves local preference. Other rows open details.
states: Browser cannot reliably read Wi-Fi SSID. OS-managed network info shown explicitly.
motion: Optional click sound only when enabled.

title: Connection lost
click: Future checks request operation ID before repeating any mutation.
states: Ambiguous completion must not be retried as a fresh reward grant.
motion: Stop analysing animation when network is lost.

title: Offline
click: Continue local experience.
states: Future offline actions need durable operation IDs; no reward before validation.
motion: Static offline icon, no error flashing.

title: Pairing and privacy
click: Informational until authenticated cloud service exists.
states: Prototype photos remain memory only; no third-party upload. LAN access is not authenticated cloud pairing.
motion: None.

title: Sync pending
click: Future retries operation queue; not implemented in this prototype.
states: Do not upload capture photos by default. Server deduplicates operation/reward IDs.
motion: Brief spinner only during real retry.

title: Save and connection
click: Read actual save adapter and browser network signal.
states: Browser online is not proof AI/cloud reachable. Remote unavailable never reported synced.
motion: No perpetual sync indicator.

title: Feature not connected
click: Return safely without mutating sample or live state.
states: Used for deferred commerce, decoration and social mutations.
motion: None.

title: Device options
click: Start continues onboarding.
states: No browser-exit or OS-shutdown action is simulated.
motion: None.

title: Rotary help
click: Return to Settings or Hello.
states: Keyboard and touch preserve the same ordered focus model.
motion: Optional illustrated pointer move, not required to understand controls.

title: Save could not finish
click: Returns to original profile/save action; never clears corrupt file automatically.
back: Home or Hello according to adoption state.
states: Corrupt server save results503. User must restore backup externally.
motion: None.
